title: Session-start line tells the agent to run /warden:upgrade, but the agent cannot
body:
What happened: the session-start message says "warden: updated to 0.2.2; this project is on 0.2.1. Run /warden:upgrade." The user also agreed in advance to the upgrade. When the agent called the skill, it was refused: "Skill warden:upgrade cannot be used with Skill tool due to disable-model-invocation. Ask the user to run /warden:upgrade themselves."
Expected: either the line is worded for the user ("ask the user to run /warden:upgrade"), or the agent is allowed to run it when the user has agreed.
Steps: start a session on a project behind the plugin version; read the session-start line; try to invoke warden:upgrade through the Skill tool.
Evidence: the exact refusal text above. The run went on with the old version (0.2.1).
note: Fixed. The agent offers the upgrade and runs /warden:upgrade after the user agrees.
